purpose: This table is a small reference lookup mapping two-letter IATA carrier codes to their full airline names, intended to feed joins from flight-fact tables that only carry the carrier code.
usage: Join on carrier to enrich flight or booking records with the human-readable carrier_name; both columns are required and non-null so no null-handling logic is needed by consumers.
limitations: The profile covers only 16 rows (one per carrier) with zero nulls and zero duplicates, so no sparsity, duplicate, or clock-drift issues were found; consumers should be aware this is a static small dimension table, not a growing fact table.
